comment_text:
A Serious Concern About the Decline in Service Quality and Package Value

When the Telenor SIM was operating under Telenor’s management, its services and packages were highly satisfactory. Call packages, social media packages, internet/data packages, and SMS packages were affordable, reliable, and provided excellent value for customers.

However, since Telenor’s operations and ownership have come under Ufone, customers have experienced a noticeable change. Many of the packages and services that were previously associated with Telenor now appear to have been shifted or converted into Ufone-oriented packages and offers.

As a customer, this creates the impression that the acquisition of Telenor has not simply been about continuing Telenor’s services, but has also resulted in customers being pushed toward Ufone products and packages.

The question is simple: Why should customers lose the quality, affordability, and flexibility they previously enjoyed with Telenor?

Customers chose Telenor because of its competitive packages and dependable services. If those benefits are gradually replaced with different packages and conditions, customers naturally feel that their choices and expectations are being ignored.

I strongly request the company to review this matter seriously, evaluate customer feedback, and restore competitive and customer-friendly packages. The company should focus on customer satisfaction rather than simply increasing the number of Ufone users.

This is not merely a complaint from one customer. It is a concern about the overall customer experience. If the company values its customers, it should listen to their feedback, investigate these concerns, and take meaningful action.

Customers deserve better service, better packages, transparency, and the freedom to choose—not to feel forced into a particular network or package.

Please take this concern seriously and review the current package structure and service quality.
